extra.message: Missing escapeFormulae option in Papaparse.unparse() call can lead to CSV formula injection vulnerability. When user-provided data is parsed into CSV format without escaping formulas, attackers can inject malicious Excel/Google Sheets formulas that execute arbitrary code when opened. The fix is to add { escapeFormulae: true } as the second argument to Papaparse.unparse(). This vulnerability falls under CWE-1236 (Improper Neutralization of Formula Elements in a CSV File) and OWASP Top 10 category A03:2021 - Injection.
